[Story]
The first group outing causes a commotion in the class, everyone gathers together to discuss the outing. Weizhi sits alone at his seat, he just transfers from the neighboring school this week. Lin Jie notices this situation from the side, he looks at Tingting who is flipping through the amusement park guide on her phone next to him, then he glances at the silent Weizhi. He coughs, turns to Tingting, signals her to look at Weizhi, and gives Tingting a suggestive smile. Tingting seems to understand something, she looks at Weizhi with confusion, nods, and walks towards Weizhi with Lin Jie.

[Question]
Why does Lin Jie give Tingting a suggestive smile?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Lin Jie and Tingting plan to go to Weizhi together in the first place.
B. Lin Jie finds Weizhi's behavior funny and wants to mock him.
C. Lin Jie wants to express his concern for Weizhi to Tingting and asks Tingting to help Weizhi with him.
D. Lin Jie just thinks of a joke about the group outing and wants to share it with Tingting.
